name: agent-kit
description: Pi tools with Effect and a Wire-assembled Go SDK for local and WebSocket remote execution

scripts.build:ts: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:go: mkdir -p .build && cd go && go build -o ../.build/runtime-runner ./cmd/runtime-runner && go build -o ../.build/remote-server ./cmd/remote-server
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:go
